version.description: Schema version of the blueprint definition. Determines which blueprint class the runner uses to execute the blueprint.

name.description: Unique identifier name for the blueprint

vars.description: Blueprint-level variables available for {variable} interpolation in phase prompts

defaults.description: Default values inherited by all phases unless overridden

phases.description: Ordered list of phases to execute in the blueprint

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks that run before or after tool calls. Set merge: true to append phase-level hooks to blueprint defaults rather than replacing them.

merge.description: When true, phase-level hooks are appended to blueprint defaults (merge mode). When false or absent, phase-level hooks replace defaults entirely (override mode, default). At the defaults level, sets the default merge behaviour for all phases.

pre_tool.description: Hook functions to run before each tool call

post_tool.description: Hook functions to run after each tool call

mcpServerStdio.description: MCP server launched as a subprocess communicating via stdio

type.description: Transport type. Optional for stdio servers — inferred when command is present.

command.description: The command to launch the MCP server process. Supports $VAR env var references.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command. Supports $VAR env var references and {variable} interpolation.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the server process. Values support $VAR env var references.

mcpServerSSE.description: Remote MCP server using Server-Sent Events transport

url.description: URL of the SSE MCP server endpoint. Supports $VAR and {variable} interpolation.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with requests. Values support $VAR env var references.

mcpServerHTTP.description: Remote MCP server using HTTP transport

url.description: URL of the HTTP MCP server endpoint. Supports $VAR and {variable} interpolation.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with requests. Values support $VAR env var references.

mcpServers.description: Named MCP server configurations. Keys are server names, values are server configs. Supports stdio (subprocess), sse (Server-Sent Events), and http transports. All string values support $VAR env var references and {variable} context interpolation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this phase, referenced by other phases

prompt.description: Instruction prompt for the agent. Supports {variable} interpolation from blueprint vars.
examples: Fetch all open tickets in epic {epic} using JIRA

load_project.description: Path to a project root from which to load the full project configuration. Loads .claude/settings.json (passed to SDK as settings path), reads CLAUDE.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md as references (appended to system prompt), scans .claude/agents/*.md as agent definitions, and registers shell command hooks as 'project_pre_tool'/'project_post_tool'. Sets cwd to the project path for subsequent prompt phases. Supports {variable} interpolation.

allowed_tools.description: Whitelist of tools the agent may call during this phase

foreach.description: Controls iteration for the phase. Accepts three forms: (1) An integer — runs the phase that many times. (2) A Jinja2 expression ({{ }}) that evaluates to an integer against prior phase results. (3) A file path — runs the phase once per non-empty line. In all modes, {index} (0-based) is injected into context. File mode also injects {item} with the line content.

condition.description: Jinja2 expression that must evaluate truthy for this phase to run. Access prior phase results via steps.<id>.success (bool) or steps.<id>.message (list). Use the 'contains' filter to search messages for a substring, or 'json_value' to parse message strings as JSON and extract a value by dot-path.

history.description: List of prior phase IDs whose prompt and text output should be included as context in this phase's prompt. Context is prepended in order before the phase's own prompt. Referenced phases must be prompt phases defined before this phase. Cannot reference foreach phases.

action.description: What to do when the phase fails

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when action is 'retry'. Defaults to 1.

notify.description: Hook function to call on failure

swarm.description: Launches a team of concurrent agents coordinating through a shared SQLite database and filesystem workspace.

goal.description: High-level objective injected into every agent's system prompt
examples: Implement user authentication with login, signup, and password reset

workspace.description: Path for shared files and SQLite DB. Supports {variable} interpolation. Default: .goblin/swarms/{phase_id}

max_iterations.description: Maximum turns per agent per round. Default: 100

timeout.description: Swarm-level timeout in seconds. No default (runs until completion or max_rounds).

cleanup.description: Workspace cleanup policy after teardown. Default: on_success

swarmCoordinator.description: The coordinator agent — decomposes the goal into tasks, assigns them to agents, and evaluates completion

examples: Break down the goal into tasks and assign to agents.

allowed_tools.description: Tool whitelist for the coordinator agent

swarmAgent.description: A worker agent in the swarm

name.description: Unique agent identifier within the swarm

examples: You are a backend engineer. Implement assigned tasks.
